question: List all buildings with their names, building numbers, building height, street address, city, state, HR department name, assignable square footage, total and average square footage, ordered in descending order of assignable, total, and average square footage.

  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.BUILDING_HEIGHT,
  a.STREET_NUMBER,
  a.CITY,
  a.STATE,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  SUM(r.AREA) AS TOTAL_SQFT,
  AVG(r.AREA) AS AVG_SQFT
FROM FCLT_BUILDING b
LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a
  ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.BUILDING_HEIGHT,
  a.STREET_NUMBER,
  a.CITY,
  a.STATE,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
